parameters.excerpt: If the address is not naturally aligned, an address-misaligned exception or an access-fault exception will be generated. The access-fault exception can be generated for a memory access that would otherwise be able to complete except for the misalignment, if the misaligned access should not be emulated.
parameters.reasoning: The implementation chooses whether to generate an address-misaligned exception or an access-fault exception for misaligned Zalasr instructions. This is a direct implementation choice not controlled by any CSR field.
